name: bug-scrub
description: Evidence-driven bug scrub for repositories and diffs, with fresh repo-context checks and optional bounded subagent analysis for large codebases.

interface.shortDescription: Find high-confidence bugs in repos and diffs.
interface.longDescription: Evidence-driven bug scrub for repositories and diffs. Refreshes repo context before accepting findings or fixes, focuses on real correctness defects, supports bounded subagent sharding for large codebases, and keeps findings tied to concrete failure paths and verification.
defaultPrompt: Bug scrub this diff vs origin/main.
Use subagents to bug scrub this large repo.
